recent_changes.description: Added SQLite PRAGMA performance tuning (64MB cache, 256MB mmap, synchronous NORMAL, temp in memory) and wrapped per-file ingest in SAVEPOINT transactions

Fixed 3 benchmark audit bugs: (1) Graph-Hybrid scoring now includes relatedEntities, (2) Blast radius traversal now supports dedicated incoming direction, (3) HitRate@1 separated from Recall@K to avoid multi-entity GT bias
Implemented Enterprise Benchmark Suite (synthetic vault generator, HotpotQA adapter, BEIR metrics evaluator, visual Mermaid quadrant and bar chart report generator)

errors_encountered.error: Graph-Hybrid search produced identical retrieval scores to Hybrid search in benchmark report
errors_encountered.solution: Fixed benchmark-engine.ts mapping to flatten relatedEntities.name alongside filePath into retrievedIds

errors_encountered.error: Blast radius F1 was abnormally low (~18%) compared to 100% on lineage and conflicts
errors_encountered.solution: Added dedicated incoming direction traversal in kHopNeighbors SQL to query upstream callers (target_id -> source_id)

errors_encountered.error: node:sqlite DatabaseSync does not have .transaction() method
errors_encountered.solution: Used manual SAVEPOINT, RELEASE, and ROLLBACK TO SQL statements

decisions_made.reason: Allows precise upstream blast radius analysis (who depends on this schema/service) without polluting results with downstream dependencies

decisions_made.decision: Separate calculateHitRateAtK() binary metric from calculateRecallAtK()
decisions_made.reason: Prevents artificial penalty on HitRate@1 when a test query has multiple expected ground truth entities

decisions_made.decision: Apply SQLite PRAGMA cache, mmap, and SAVEPOINT batching in core engine
decisions_made.reason: Significantly accelerates write throughput and FTS5 querying without introducing external database dependencies
